experimentalProjection.scope: Source-coordinate rendering experiment; original game layer projection has not been confirmed by runtime evidence. Stand clips are non-looping and should hold their final frame.

mapping.position: (x,z,-y)/128; add the background root world translation when lights are not parented to that root
mapping.intensity: Source numeric intensity copied without physical-unit conversion or exposure compensation
mapping.sourceAmbient: All five local light ambient intensities are zero. This does not establish the original global environment lighting.
mapping.isolation: RawImage render_root filters geometry only; menu lights and battle lights must have separate active states. Global environment and directional lighting are not defined by these five source lights.

lighting.staticEvidence: Each LITE entry has an unparented 96-byte node and 44-byte fixed light payload with no animation tracks; its pivot and light values remain constant throughout Stand.

logo.scope: Original static logo texture; animated logo presentation has not been validated.
